observations: With the imported source unchanged, permissive output stops at FIELD/FIELDLIST serialization.

Removing those VIEWPORT entities leaves dangling LAYOUT viewport membership. Clearing viewport memberships and last-active handles then advances, but the source SORTENTSTABLE extension DICTIONARY reciprocity gate fails.

After dropping the SORTENTSTABLE graph, the projection exposes ACAD_GROUP and ACAD_LAYOUT NOD dependencies, dynamic-block output refusal, DICTIONARYWDFLT root/import dependencies, named-resource receipt consistency, and CELLSTYLEMAP/TABLESTYLE closure in sequence. These are independent graph profiles, not additional LayerStates dependencies.

A second diagnostic projection cleared the unrelated TABLESTYLE/CELLSTYLEMAP family and reached VISUALSTYLE closure. The physical AC1021 source contains 16 decoded typed VisualStyles, no raw DXF carriers, all owned by dictionary 0x99 with one reactor each. Existing typed DWG-to-DXF admission is limited to the source-qualified AC1024 profile; no AC1021 field-to-DXF serializer profile is established. The projection still refused before output and retained the destination sentinel.
